scene: The glowing orchid lights up three secret exits from the grove.
picture: Flat side-view along a level stone quay. On the far left, a red bento express train waits on tracks. The grandfather stands left of centre holding a glowing orchid by his bicycle. At the centre, a carved koi boat floats by the edge. On the far right stands a brass birdcage lift.
shown: A steaming red rail-car resting on tracks at the far left edge
A giant carved wooden carp boat bobbing in water at the centre
A brass birdcage elevator with open lattice gates on the far right
